mapper.sql: t.id, t.code, t.name, t.form_type, t.version, t.status, t.node_count, t.form_schema_json, t.published_at, t.created_at, t.created_by, t.updated_at, t.updated_by, t.max_return_count, t.max_supplement_count, t.supplement_deadline_days, t.supplement_deadline_type, t.on_supplement_timeout, t.withdraw_window
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flow_template t WHERE t.code = #{code} ORDER BY t.version DESC, t.id DESC
SELECT FROM flow_template t WHERE t.code = #{code} AND t.status = #{status} ORDER BY t.version DESC, t.id DESC
SELECT FROM flow_template t WHERE t.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM flow_template t WHERE t.code = #{code} AND t.version = #{version} LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(t.version) FROM flow_template t WHERE t.code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_template (code, name, form_type, version, status, node_count, form_schema_json, max_return_count, max_supplement_count, supplement_deadline_days, supplement_deadline_type, on_supplement_timeout, withdraw_window, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{formType}, #{version}, #{status}, IFNULL(#{nodeCount}, 0), #{formSchemaJson}, #{maxReturnCount}, #{maxSupplementCount}, #{supplementDeadlineDays}, #{supplementDeadlineType}, #{onSupplementTimeout}, #{withdrawWindow}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_template SET name = #{name}, form_schema_json = #{formSchemaJson}, node_count = IFNULL(#{nodeCount}, node_count), max_return_count = #{maxReturnCount}, max_supplement_count = #{maxSupplementCount}, supplement_deadline_days = #{supplementDeadlineDays}, supplement_deadline_type = #{supplementDeadlineType}, on_supplement_timeout = #{onSupplementTimeout}, withdraw_window = #{withdrawWindow}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'draft'
UPDATE flow_template SET status = #{status}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'published' THEN NOW() ELSE published_at END, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
